title: Isolation Placement and the Tier Pricing the Therapeutic Opening Charge
content:
**Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations — a held room under isolation placement, therapeutic opening charge.**

*When is a held room an isolation placement?* The room held counts as an isolation placement when the resident's Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency agreement carries an isolation placement and the agreement's tier is the tier of the room held, the agreement's last room change, the center's infection-control move, being dated no later than the departure date; such a room is priced at its isolation billing tier, as the private-pay agreement prices that room's room and board: a private secure memory care room at the semi-private secure memory care tier and any other private room at the semi-private long-term care tier; any other room held is priced at its own tier.

*Which agreement is looked at?* The agreement read is the resident's current Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency agreement: the agreement that is active, else the one in its notice period, else the one converted to another payer source.

*Which tier prices the room, case by case?*

- Private Secure Memory Care Room, isolation placement on the agreement in that tier, last room change dated no later than the departure date: Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room.
- Private Long-Term Care Room, Private Bariatric Care Room or Private Suite with Sitting Area, isolation placement on the agreement in that tier, last room change dated no later than the departure date: Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room.
- No isolation placement, a last room change dated after the departure date or not on the agreement, or an agreement on a different tier from the room held: the room held's own tier.
- A semi-private room held: its own tier.

**Date boundary.** A last room change dated on the departure date itself is no later than the departure date and counts; one dated the day after the departure date does not, and the room is priced at its own tier.
